title: GLTF naming version being overriden wrongly in .import file
body:
[gltf-name.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26876446/gltf-name.zip)

### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.7 dev 5
- Not reproducible in 4.7 dev 4

### System information

Godot v4.7.dev5 - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop GPU (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.9579) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-12700H (20 threads) - 63.74 GiB memory

### Issue description

It seems `gltf/texture_map_mode` was introduced in the GLTF import settings in 4.7 dev 5, but when the .import files are automatically updated to add this parameter, it also overrides the `gltf/naming_version` line to value 0 regardless of what was there before. All of my glb .import files that had `gltf/naming_version=1` or `gltf/naming_version=2` got force updated to `gltf/naming_version=0`, even if the parameter was already there in the previous .import files.

The specific case where this happens is when:

- GLB file has embedded texture
- import is set to discard all textures

In 4.7 dev 4, the the end of the file will look like:

```
_subresources={}
gltf/naming_version=2
gltf/embedded_image_handling=0
```

in 4.7 dev 5, the end of the file will auto update to:

```
_subresources={}
gltf/naming_version=0
gltf/embedded_image_handling=0
gltf/texture_map_mode=1
```

This is a fairly big problem because the scenes depend on how the GLTF is interpreted to create the scene tree hierarchy, and the scenes that inherit this GLB will lose their references with different naming versions.

The workaround is to manually revert the modification of this line in the import file with a diff tool, but keep the gltf/texture_map_mode line, so it won't trigger an auto update of the parameters anymore.

### Steps to reproduce

Have a glb file **with an embedded texture** and its import file with the parameter `embedded_image_handling=0` (Discard All Textures) and `gltf/naming_version` with a value other than 0 from a previous official version (any before 4.7 dev 5). Godot will automatically add the `gltf/texture_map_mode` line and reset `gltf/naming_version` to 0.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

This is a 4.7 dev 4 project, with a simple embedded texture glb file and the import settings described above:

```
_subresources={}
gltf/naming_version=2
gltf/embedded_image_handling=0
```

Upon opening the project in 4.7 dev 5, it'll automatically become:

```
_subresources={}
gltf/naming_version=0
gltf/embedded_image_handling=0
gltf/texture_map_mode=1
```

setting naming version to 0 regardless of what was there before.
